import numpy as np

def move(terrain, start, duration_s, n_runs, seed):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    n_steps = 60
    dt = duration_s / (n_steps - 1)
    lat0, lon0 = start
    points = np.empty((n_runs, n_steps, 3), dtype=np.float64)
    points[:, 0, 0] = lat0
    points[:, 0, 1] = lon0
    points[:, 0, 2] = 0.0
    # Staying put: same lat/lon at all times
    points[:, 1:, 0] = lat0
    points[:, 1:, 1] = lon0
    seconds = np.linspace(0, duration_s, n_steps)
    points[:, :, 2] = seconds

    ok = terrain.inside(points[:, -1, 0], points[:, -1, 1])
    return points, ok
